findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

Recovery releases every follow-up consumed by the failed run, even when the runner received that follow-up and sent its reply before crashing. The item becomes available to the next turn and can be presented twice. Release only follow-ups that were not confirmed as handled.
findings.title: Not done: No message is lost or given twice

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

An ordinary exhausted final retry sets acknowledgeFailedTurn even when no reply or failure notice was delivered. handleFailure then returns without releasing the consumed input. The next turn cannot take the unanswered message.
findings.title: Not done: No message is lost or given twice

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

The added child workers call takeInput and getMessagesByIds directly, then exit. They never run admission, deliver a continuation to a runner, or send a reply. The active-turn follow-up case uses workers in one process with a stubbed runner. These tests cannot detect loss or duplication during the required two-process owner handoff.
findings.title: Not done: two-process no-loss/no-duplication test

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

takeInput selects items by receiveOrder, but this sort gives provider timestamps precedence. A delayed attachment or a provider timestamp that moves backward can appear before an earlier received message in the agent's batch. Use receiveOrder for items that have it.
findings.title: Present taken messages in receive order

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

This added file records a prior review result and task status. It is outside the permitted paths and is unnecessary for the runtime switch, migration, tests, or decision update.
findings.title: Remove the review-state file outside the allowed scope

findings.body:
chunk 3/3:

An active turn's follow-up is marked consumed by takeInput before the runner confirms it reached the model. The owner marks a continuation applied after calling the local hook, but group-queue-live-turn-hooks.ts can return without writing when the runner is no longer active. If the turn ends in that window, the follow-up is absent from later takes and ordinary terminal handling does not release it. Release follow-ups that were not confirmed as received by the runner.
findings.title: Not done: No message is lost or given twice

findings.body:
chunk 3/3:

Callable-agent completions are admitted with triggerDecision.requiresTrigger=false (async-delegated-agent-follow-up.ts:117), but this turn-start check uses only the message text and route trigger policy. In a mention-required conversation without a qualifying thread root, the completion has no mention, so the already-consumed item is treated as history and never reaches the agent. Preserve the trusted admission decision when checking this input.
findings.title: Not done: No message is lost or given twice

findings.body:
chunk 3/3:

The cross-process portion tests only repository takeInput/getMessagesByIds. The added active-turn test constructs both workers in one process and replaces the runner control port and agent with callbacks. It therefore cannot fail when separate processes lose or duplicate a follow-up between admission, owner command delivery, and reply. Extend the process-spawned test through the live entry point and assert the delivered messages and replies.
findings.title: Not done: two-process e2e
